about: 2 Minute Tabletop token for each bestiary stat block, keyed <page-slug>#<stat-block-id> (English ids, so one file serves every language). 'choice' is the list of tokens picked (several for a pair or a group, e.g. the Quiet Twins; null = undecided, "none" = no token); 'options' are the proposals, best first. A token id is <set>:<category>/<file>; the sets are folders under the repo root.
